proposals.evidence: DEDR3491 gives Kannada doḍḍa big and doḍḍitu/doḍḍittu that which is large, Tamil toṭṭa big and Kota doḍ big/great. These survey doḍḍ-/toṭṭ- adjectives and ordinary neuter forms belong with that family; source voicing, gemination and final-vowel differences are retained. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2646 gives Kannada cikki/cikke star, Gadaba sukka and Gondi sukkum/huko/hukka/ukkum/ukka/ukam star. Selected cukk-/sukk-/ukk- survey nouns preserve documented sibilant weakening, stem-final vowels and ordinary plural endings. DEDR explicitly marks Tamil cukkai as a Telugu loan; no Tamil response is included in this inherited-family proposal. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 gives Tamil cem-/civa- red with past -nt-, Malayalam cem-/covva/cuvappu/cōppu red, and Kannada kempu. These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
